owner_correction: Pangram GUI does not require Work when Chat itself has direct connected-computer/browser/terminal access.
normalized_rule: Route by actual capability of the current Chat surface, not by action category alone. A terminal, browser, GUI, remote-desktop, filesystem, or OS action remains in Chat when Chat has a direct authorized tool that can reliably perform it. Work/Codex is required only when the needed execution capability is unavailable or impractical in Chat, or the operation is genuinely long-range/stateful enough to merit delegation.
causal_failure: The prior routing list treated terminal commands and browser/computer/OS automation as unconditional Work triggers. This contradicted the higher-level rule that Work is for execution Chat cannot reliably perform and caused an unnecessary Work handoff despite direct connected-computer capability being available in Chat.
enforcement: Before admitting Work for an execution task, inventory the current Chat surface's direct authorized tools for that exact action.
Do not treat remote execution as non-Chat merely because the command or browser runs on another machine; a connected-computer or remote-desktop tool exposed directly to Chat counts as Chat execution.
Delegate only the residual action Chat cannot reliably perform or when sustained stateful execution is genuinely impractical in Chat.
nonclaims: This does not make every Chat surface capable of local execution.
This does not bypass user approvals, credentials, spending, destructive-action, publication, privacy, or other hard gates.
This does not authorize free-form GUI action when a safer deterministic tool exists.
origin: Owner correction during Inner Child Therapy humanization after an unnecessary Work handoff was proposed for a Pangram GUI run while direct connected-computer tooling was available in Chat.
